task: Push digit WAM continuous policy replay
spatial_transform: One fixed crop for all clips; 3x Lanczos spatial upscale only.
timing: 25 fps real-time samples at every 20 physics steps (DT=0.002 s), plus exact evaluation endpoints. Endpoints between video ticks appear on the next tick (under 40 ms later); shorter methods hold their final state. After all endpoints, 20 explicitly labeled final-state frames hold the clock. No temporal interpolation.
physics: Exact exporter model and evaluator loop, including one-time pusher velocity reset. No added forward calls during stepping. Goal geoms appended to mjvScene only; no goal physics body.
evidence: Actual observation-camera simulation replay of saved generated actions; not a new policy inference. Illustrative examples; selection rationale is retained per clip and is not aggregate performance.
